HookTitle.use: Kinetic text for the first 2 seconds

SerpVsAiAnswer.use: Split screen: blue links versus an AI answer card

props.look: brutal | soft | line | chat ? (overrides the episode's cardStyle)
props.sources: string[]? (chips under the answer in soft/chat looks)
props.label: string? (default 'AI answer')

CitationCards.use: Source cards stacking, one highlighted as cited

props.look: brutal | soft | line | chat ? (overrides the episode's cardStyle)

StatCounter.use: A number counting up with its source

KeywordCloud.use: Floating terms, one pulsing; the default fallback

Checklist.use: Items ticking in one by one

props.items: (string | {text, at: '<spoken word>'})[] — ticks on its word
props.title: string?

props.look: brutal | soft | line | chat ? (overrides the episode's cardStyle)

BrowserFrame.use: Footage or a screenshot inside a browser window

props.title: string?
props.look: brutal | soft | line | chat ? (overrides the episode's cardStyle)

BigQuestion.use: Podus-style: one big plain question in black type on paper

Diagram.use: THE default explainer graphic (reference style): icons, logos, emoji stickers or fetched photos with short labels, joined by arrows/curves, '+' signs or a brace, building in one by one

props.nodes: [{icon?: 'logo:youtube' | 'emoji:🎓' | 'line:users' | 'text:+10M', query?: 'photo search', label?, sub?, at?: seconds}]
props.brace: string | true (brace under a row, optional caption)
props.title: string?

Toggle.use: A settings switch flipping on, e.g. 'Monetization', optional icon above

DeviceFrame.use: Phone or laptop showing a clip/screenshot, optional sticker + big text beside it

ProfileList.use: Header icon + cards appearing one by one (channels, accounts, tools, niches)

CTAEnd.use: Follow card with the avatar waving (use as cta.visual)

SearchBar3D.use: Google search bar in 3D perspective typing a query (operators like site: highlighted) with Google-coloured shapes behind

NodeNetwork3D.use: Entities linking into a knowledge graph

Waveform.use: Gradient audio bars pulsing — voice, podcast, sound, dialogue

RedditFeed.use: Real-looking Reddit post cards stacking in like a feed (no made-up counts) — questions people ask, community proof

ToolStack.use: App cards for tools / plans / options with real logo tiles, each arriving on its word; mark one picked (check), skipped (greys + strike) or added (+ ADD), optional stamp over the stack

props.title: string? (small caps label above)
props.items: [{name, sub?, icon?: 'assets/manual/logo-x.png' | 'logo:semrush' | 'line:search', tag?, at?: word, mark?: 'check' | 'skip' | 'plus', markAt?: word}]
props.still: boolean? (cards already in place: a follow-up beat on the same stack)

DashboardBloat.use: Hook graphic for 'more tools/features isn't better': a tidy analytics dashboard bloats (bigger, more widgets, alert dots) then collapses into one clean picked card

props.pickAt: word? - clutter collapses into the picked card

Streak.use: Consistency / habit: a row of weeks or days ticking orange one after another
